rows.text: Question: The IPC distributed Synesthesia Beacons that allow animals to communicate with other intelligent lifeforms. Now that all animals can talk, why do the kittens remain silent?
rows.speaker: "Shush"

rows.text: Answer: Because the "cat got their tongue"! Cat and kittens, get it?
rows.speaker: "Shush"

rows.text: Somehow, you can sense a deep, lingering pity in the eyes of this unfamiliar Ruan Mei creation.
*sigh* You've strayed much too far down the Path of "Terrible Puns."
But it's not too late. Come, follow the guidance of "Akivimeow" and return to the Path of "Trailblaze"!
Aki-what now?
It's "A-ki-vi-meow"! Meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Don't you dare touch our Emanator of Terrible Puns!
You mean this guy is actually an Emanator?
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Fine! If that's how it is... then I'll just have to get an Emanator of my own, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Cute little fellow! You wanna come home with me?
You think that same old trick will work on me? I'm not like those other lost ones!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Listen up, new passenger. I am Akivili, the Aeon of "Trailblaze," reborn in the form of a cake.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Feed me 50 snacks, and I'll appoint you as my Emanator!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Looks like Aha has found THEIR way onto the Express again!
I'm not lying! Don't you dare doubt my Trailblazing will, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Is being an Emanator actually a good thing?
You get to join me in rescuing these poor little fellas who've got lost, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: I wanna be the Emanator of the Trailblaze!
That's the spirit! I knew I was right about you, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Meow~ These little guys were born from chaos, but lucky for them, you were willing to take them in and give them a home to shelter from wind and rain.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: But to survive on the Express, they gotta learn the essence of Trailblaze and walk the meow-velous path of Trailblaze. And THAT is what I'm made for!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: In the future, I shall return here from time to time. You may recount to me their little acts of mischief... Meow, I mean, visit me on their behalf and listen to my teachings.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Once you get what I mean, I'll bestow upon you a reward from Akivimeow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow
